english.note: Use this more explicit term when you need to identify the pile specifically as a funeral pyre rather than an ordinary fire pile.

examples.english: Ancient texts record that the dead were burned on a funeral pyre.
examples.traditional: 古籍記載，死者會放喺火葬堆上焚化。
